caption: The drawing consists of a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object has a triangular, almost teardrop-shaped upper portion, with an openwork design composed of several geometric shapes and patterns, including curved lines, diamonds, and interlocking ovals. The central part of the triangular section contains a circular motif with angular and swirling forms. The lower section features an extended handle with three circular cutouts of varying sizes along its length. The entire object is rendered in shades of dark gray, suggesting a metallic appearance, and there are no other objects or colors present in the composition. The name “LeRoy Griffith” appears in small, hand-written text at the bottom right of the page.
